remarks: A considerable price reduction for this updated and just recently listed, immaculate house on a peaceful tree-lined street which offers 2-3 bedrooms and more. To fully appreciate it, the house needs to be seen in person. New plumbing, new electric, new foam insulation, etc. Large sunroom leading to a new deck and backyard. Spacious basement with high ceilings has a tremendous potential for those who would like to expand. The property has a generous fenced front yard, garage and professionally landscaped very spacious backyard illuminated in the evening hours. A very inviting and fully renovated with a privacy gate and a large patio backyard will be a wonderful space for your spring, summer and fall BBQ parties and outdoor dinners. Located at the highest point of the street, this property dominates the area and is a pride of ownership.
